questions.text: A is the wife of B. B is the brother of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
questions.solution: Level 1 (The Parents' Generation): A is the wife of B. (A is female, B is male). B is the brother of C. (B and C are siblings. C is male since he is a father). So, A (Wife) = B (Brother) - C (F ather). Level 2 (The Children's Generation): C is the father of D. (D is the child of C). Place D below C. The Connection: B is D's paternal Uncle (father's brother). A is the wife of B. Therefore, A is D's

questions.text: Three runners start from the same point on a 300 m circular track at 5 m/s, 6 m/s and 10 m/s. When will they all meet again at the starting point?
What will come in place of (?) 2, 6, 18, 54,?
questions.solution: Given: 6, 18, 54,?, 486 Logic: Number are multiply by 3. 6 x 3 = 18 18 x 3 = 54 54 x 3 = 162 162 x 3 = 486 So, the missing term is 162. Thus, correct option is (d).

questions.text:
Read the sentence below carefully. The blank requires an idiom that describes a state of affairs contrary to its literal meaning, specifically where a lack of official recognition leads to an outcome typically associated with authority or celebration in Indian administrative contexts.

'Since no one from the district administration had issued a formal ______ for the rural artisans' fair, the local police station, in a display of civic pride, ended up issuing a commendation letter that felt like a royal decree to the crowd.'

Which idiom best fits the blank to reflect the missing official sanction?
questions.solution: The context requires an 'official sanction' or permission. A 'green signal' is an idiom for approval/permission. The sentence describes a lack of this, so 'no one had issued a formal green signal' fits the bureaucratic gap before the police stepped in.
questions.style: The 'Semantic Inversion' Mechanism applied to Idiom Usage within a Bureaucratic Narrative

questions.text: Passage: 'The pandemic accelerated the adoption of digital payments in India. UPI transactions surged from 1.3 billion in 2018 to over 84 billion in 2023. However, the rapid growth has also led to an increase in digital payment fraud, with cybercriminals devising new methods to trick users.' Which of the following best describes the relationship described in the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Digital payments decreased after the pandemic

options.label: B
options.text: Growth in digital payments has been accompanied by a rise in fraud

options.label: D
options.text: Cybercriminals were unaffected by digital growth

questions.solution: Correct answer: Growth in digital payments has been accompanied by a rise in fraud.
